strength.title: STRENGTH
strength.desc: Physical strength. How much damage you can do with melee weapons and how much you can carry. Also increases shove distance.

endurance.title: ENDURANCE
endurance.desc: Personal endurance. Determines your maximum health as well as how little food and sleep you need.

precision.title: PRECISION
precision.desc: Your agility and deftness. How well you can handle most fire arms.

intellect.title: INTELLECT
intellect.desc: General intelligence. Helps with everything from first aid to smarts and security.

luck.title: LUCK
luck.desc: You believe in luck, right? It helps with just about every task, even in getting a critical shot.

blunt.title: BLUNT
blunt.desc: Skill with blunt weapons such as bats, clubs and hammers. Determines damage with these weapons.

blades.title: BLADES
blades.desc: Skill with bladed weapons such as knives, axes and chainsaws. Determines damage with these weapons.

pistols.title: PISTOLS
pistols.desc: Skill with handguns including semi-automatics and revolvers. Determines accuracy and damage with these weapons.

longGuns.title: LONG GUNS
longGuns.desc: Skill with long barrelled weapons including rifles and shotguns. Determines accuracy and damage with these weapons.

automatics.title: AUTOMATICS
automatics.desc: Skill with automatics, assault rifles and sub machine guns. Determines accuracy and damage with these weapons.

specialWeapons.title: SPECIAL WEAPONS
specialWeapons.desc: Skill with special weapons including launchers. Determines accuracy and damage with these weapons.

sneak.title: SNEAK
sneak.desc: Ability to move silently without being detected.

smarts.title: SMARTS
smarts.desc: General mental ability. Helps with trade, getting more benefit from books and earning extra XP.

security.title: SECURITY
security.desc: Ability to get past security of all types including locked doors and digital security.

searching.title: SEARCHING
searching.desc: Ability to find additional items when searching. Reduces the amount of junk found.

speech.title: SPEECH
speech.desc: Ability to convince others to come around to your point of view.

firstAid.title: FIRST AID
firstAid.desc: Ability to treat wounds effectively and quickly. Increases benefit from health items.

survival.title: SURVIVAL
survival.desc: General endurance for withstanding a survival situation. Reduces requirements for food and increases damage resistance.

fitness.title: FITNESS
fitness.desc: Physical fitness ability. Reduces the amount of stamina used when shoving, jumping and using melee weapons.
